task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an profound round of TextWorld? You do! Here is your task for today. First thing I need you to do is to try to take a trip north. Once you succeed at that, try to venture north. And then, try to venture east. And then, head east. That done, try to travel south. And then, make an attempt to go to the south. With that over with, take a trip south. Then, try to go west. With that over with, open the door. After that, make an effort to move south. And then, take a trip west. With that done, retrieve the loaf of bread from the floor of the cookhouse. And once you've done that, you win!
